text.hi: किताब कहती है: सोचो तुम कहानी वाला ऊँट हो। ‘मैं’ से कहानी लिखो। इन शब्दों का इस्तेमाल करो: lake, tracks, footprints, went back, happy, leaves, lost, sand।
text.hinglish: Kitaab kehti hai: socho tum kahani waala oont ho. ‘Main’ se kahani likho. In shabdon ka istemaal karo: lake, tracks, footprints, went back, happy, leaves, lost, sand.
text.en: The book says: imagine you are the camel in the story. Write the story as ‘I’, using: lake, tracks, footprints, went back, happy, leaves, lost, sand.

prompt.hi: ऊँट बोलता है: एक दिन मैं रेगिस्तान में खो गया।
prompt.hinglish: Oont bolta hai: ek din main registaan mein kho gaya.
prompt.en: As the camel: say you got lost in the desert.

steps.answer: One day I got lost in the desert.

meaning.hi: एक दिन मैं रेगिस्तान में खो गया।
meaning.hinglish: Ek din main registaan mein kho gaya.

prompt.hi: शब्द: leaves — मैंने रास्ते की झाड़ियों के पत्ते खाए।
prompt.hinglish: Shabd: leaves — maine raaste ki jhaadiyon ke patte khaaye.
prompt.en: Word: leaves. Say you ate leaves on the way.

steps.answer: I ate the leaves of the bushes on the way.

meaning.hi: मैंने रास्ते में झाड़ियों के पत्ते खाए।
meaning.hinglish: Maine raaste mein jhaadiyon ke patte khaaye.

prompt.hi: शब्द: lake — मैं पानी पीने एक झील पर गया।
prompt.hinglish: Shabd: lake — main paani peene ek jheel par gaya.
prompt.en: Word: lake. Say you went to a lake to drink water.

steps.answer: I went to a lake to drink water.

meaning.hi: मैं पानी पीने एक झील पर गया।
meaning.hinglish: Main paani peene ek jheel par gaya.

prompt.hi: शब्द: footprints, sand — मेरे पैरों के निशान रेत पर रह गए।
prompt.hinglish: Shabd: footprints, sand — mere pairon ke nishaan ret par reh gaye.
prompt.en: Words: footprints, sand. Say your footprints stayed on the sand.

steps.answer: My footprints were left on the sand.

meaning.hi: मेरे पैरों के निशान रेत पर रह गए।
meaning.hinglish: Mere pairon ke nishaan ret par reh gaye.

prompt.hi: शब्द: went back, happy — मैं अपने मालिकों के पास वापस गया और ख़ुश था।
prompt.hinglish: Shabd: went back, happy — main apne maalikon ke paas waapas gaya aur khush tha.
prompt.en: Words: went back, happy. Say you went back to your owners and were happy.

steps.answer: I went back to my owners and I was very happy.

meaning.hi: मैं अपने मालिकों के पास वापस गया और बहुत ख़ुश था।
meaning.hinglish: Main apne maalikon ke paas waapas gaya aur bahut khush tha.

steps.question: Give a title to your story. Which title fits best?

questionMeaning.hi: अपनी कहानी को नाम दो। कौन सा नाम सबसे अच्छा है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Apni kahani ko naam do. Kaun sa naam sabse achha hai?
